title: HTTPS leafnode proxies can receive credentials without TLS
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server can establish outgoing leafnode connections through an HTTP CONNECT proxy.

### Problem Description

An HTTPS proxy URL was accepted without establishing TLS to the proxy before sending the CONNECT request. Proxy credentials could consequently be exposed to an observer on the network path to the proxy. TLS between the leafnode and its destination does not protect this separate proxy exchange.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-42wr-c22f-4h5c>
